'''Senn Riip Domeet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], a member of the terrorist organization [[The Flail]] and its main expert in explosives. Prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Domeet took part in an attempted coup against [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Disguised as a construction worker, Domeet hid a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] in the [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorlift platform]] Valorum was to use the following day. After finishing his work, Domeet noticed that he had been sighted, and tried to escape.<ref name="Shadows" />
